title: unified-rollouts: proactive-shadow-canary-autorollback-improvements
author: Marco Li
description: Motivation: Improve safety and stability of proactive shadow canary deployments by tightening probing, adding quorum-based metric evaluation, and making the autorollback engine resilient to noisy telemetry. This PR introduces a probing scheduler for shadow traffic that performs staggered multi-stage probes, a quorum evaluator that aggregates per-region and per-model metrics before triggering rollback decisions, and several safety gates to avoid oscillations. Key changes: 1) Probing scheduler with jittered windows and backoff on transient failures; 2) Quorum-based metric collector that supports weighted regions and composite metrics; 3) Hysteresis and cool-down settings for autorollback to prevent churn; 4) New observability hooks (per-probe traces, probe-level histograms) and dashboards; 5) E2E stability guards and additional unit/integration tests. Rollout plan: merged behind feature flag rollout.autorollback.proactive_shadow_enabled; staged rollout to internal canary orgs for 2 weeks, followed by wider ramp once stability metrics are green. Related: ENG-3214 (proactive rollouts design), ENG-3302 (observability for autorollback).

+++ engine.go: added CooldownManager and HysteresisState to prevent immediate re-rollouts; pseudocode: if consecutive_failures >= quorum && !in_cooldown -> trigger_rollback()
+++ quorum_aggregator.py: supports composite metrics (latency+error_rate) with weighted thresholds per-region

release_notes: Improved proactive shadow canary autorollback: safer probing scheduler, quorum-based metric evaluation, hysteresis and cooldown guards, observability for probe-level metrics. Feature gated under rollout.autorollback.proactive_shadow_enabled.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for scheduler jitter, quorum aggregator logic, and autorollback cooldown behavior. Integration tests added for staged shadow flow with mocked telemetry. Recommend enabling feature flag in internal canary orgs and monitoring autorollback.* metrics for at least 48 hours before wider rollout.
backout_plan: Feature is feature-flagged. In case of issues: 1) disable rollout.autorollback.proactive_shadow_enabled via config service; 2) force rollback of any in-progress rollouts using admin console; 3) revert merged commit and redeploy if DB schema changes observed (no schema changes in this PR).
notes_for_release_manager: This PR is safe for minor release once validated in canaries. No DB migrations. Add observability dashboards to release notes and ensure sampling defaults are communicated to SRE to avoid cost spikes.
changelog_entry: Proactive shadow canary autorollback: added safer probing scheduler, quorum-based evaluation, and cooldown/hysteresis to reduce false positives. (feature-flagged)
performance_notes: Microbenchmarks show probe scheduling overhead < 2ms per request and quorum aggregation adds ~4ms p95 to the autorollback decision path. Batching and async collection used to minimize request-path latency impact.
